procedure: Verify source PNG, original native ARGB, source-input and per-pair geometry hashes before any candidate comparison.
Select the exact source case and reproduce its camera, projection, world/plane, controlled container state, model/shape/orientation, source animation frame and recorded native terrain tint.
Retain full1920x1080 pixel accounting, source scale128, negative-up heights,16384 scene angle units, stock root161 and native UIscale1.

Apply the unchanged native_scene_model limits to the matching scene and the unchanged native_hud zero-error requirements to source UI/control/glyph geometry. No image rescaling, translational registration or new tolerance is introduced.
Derive the existing one-pixel scene edge band from the SOURCE before evaluating a candidate, under the approved policy. Never mask a whole panel, creature, scenery layer or failing geometry.
Do not subtract source-to-source pair differences from candidate errors. They describe controlled state changes, not acceptance allowances.
The sidebar container includes world-visible gutters. Their pixels are retained in the complete matching source case; the full native inventory panel remains exact across these source pairs.
Evaluate the locked-camera roof branch shown in the images separately from the recorded normal-camera selector. Do not relabel one as the other or infer authenticated progression.
Keep the explicitly controlled open orientation and mapped-chunk qualifications. These references do not establish unobserved server packets or live timing.
